category_title: Shy students with limited verbal output who require prompting to communicate ideas
minimal_context: The student is in a whole-class setting using an iPad app to narrate a story and add details to a character.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are going to narrate the story for the class. Please add some detail to the main character.

STUDENT: He is tall.

TUTOR: What else can you tell us about him?

STUDENT: I don't know. Someone else can do it.

TUTOR: Just try to add one more detail to the incident.

STUDENT: He walked.

options.A: Redirect the student to the narration task fairly quickly and emphasize the importance of staying focused.
options.B: Create a simple 'walk-through guide' that the student can access whenever they need to troubleshoot the app.
options.C: Use the app to video parts of the story and use photos to provide ideas for dialogue.
options.D: Self-disclose a parallel personal tragedy to establish a deep emotional connection during the narration activity.
